blocks.text: Standard model un theories ka collection (majmooa) hai jo experiments mein dekhe gaye sab se chhote particles aur energy aur matter ke aapas ke interaction ko describe (bayan) karti hain. Standard model particles ki teen categories (qismon) se bana hai (Fig. 12.8): quarks, leptons aur bosons. Matter (maadda), jo universe ka sirf 5% hai, quarks aur leptons se bana hai. Fundamental bosons teen forces dete hain: electromagnetism, strong nuclear force aur weak nuclear force.

blocks.alt: Do hisson wala chart. Fermions (matter): purple panel mein quarks aur antiquarks, up, charm aur top oopar aur down, strange aur bottom neeche, har ek apne antiquark ke saath; green panel mein leptons aur antileptons, electron, muon aur tau neutrinos oopar aur electron, muon aur tau neeche, har ek apne antiparticle ke saath. Bosons: photon, gluon, Z aur W 'force carriers' ke taur par, aur un ke neeche Higgs boson h.

blocks.long_description: Har antiparticle apne particle ke peeche aur neeche doosri disc par hai; us ka symbol bar ke saath (ū, d̄, ν̄) ya charged leptons ke liye plus ke saath (e⁺, μ⁺, τ⁺) likha hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chart ke teen hisse dekhein: purple hissa quarks (chhe qismein), green hissa leptons (chhe qismein) aur daen taraf bosons. Quarks aur leptons mil kar matter (fermions) banate hain. Photon (gamma) electromagnetic force, gluon (g) strong force, aur Z aur W weak force carry karte hain; Higgs boson (h) batata hai ke particles mass kaise pate hain. Har particle ke peeche wali disc us ka antiparticle hai. Kitab ki picture mein antiparticle ka symbol ulta (upside-down) chhapa hai, jis se ulta d 'p' aur ulta b 'q' jaisa parha jata hai; is liye yahan kitab ke text wala tareeqa use hua hai: symbol ke oopar bar (jaise d̄), aur charged leptons ke liye + (jaise e⁺).
2012 mein discover hone wala Higgs boson batata hai ke doosre particles mass kaise pate hain.

Yeh model abhi incomplete (adhoora) mana jata hai. Yeh maloom universe ki kai important baaton ko explain nahi kar sakta, jaise: (i) gravity, (ii) dark matter (universe ka 27%) aur (iii) dark energy (universe ka 68%).

blocks.prompt: Elementary particles ki classification (darja bandi) describe kijiye (comprehensive question 12.8). Electroweak theory kis ne pesh ki (MCQ 12.15)?
blocks.explanation: Standard Model mein elementary particles do qism ke hain: fermions, jo matter banate hain, aur bosons, jo forces carry karte hain. Fermions mein chhe quarks (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom), jo hadrons banate hain (teen quarks ke baryons, quark aur antiquark ke mesons), aur chhe leptons (electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos) hain; har ek ka antiparticle hai. Bosons photon, gluons, W aur Z, aur Higgs boson hain. Electroweak theory, jo electromagnetic aur weak forces ko milati hai, Dr. Abdus Salam ne Glashow aur Weinberg ke saath banai (Nobel Prize 1979): option (d).

items: Standard Model: quarks aur leptons (matter, universe ka taqreeban 5%) aur electromagnetic, strong aur weak forces dene wale bosons; Higgs boson (2012) mass ko explain karta hai. Yeh abhi gravity, dark matter (27%) ya dark energy (68%) ko explain nahi karta.
